disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.en: Scanned all source code and configs for secret patterns (API keys, tokens, cloud credentials, SSH private keys, etc.); no hardcoded credentials detected.

checked_items.en: Checked access paths to user credential files; no reads found. The only local data the plugin reads is the session chain-of-thought log required by its declared functionality.

evidence.en: No code paths found that read system credential files or send session data to external networks; chain-of-thought text flows only locally. Its local exposure surface is covered in finding DG-D6.

checked_items.zh: 审查了注入模型上下文的所有文本面：系统提示段、干预提示、L2 重置的 persona 文本，均为功能自述或中性建议式措辞，未发现指令覆写或诱导性内容。
checked_items.en: Reviewed all text surfaces injected into the model context: system prompt segment, intervention prompts, and persona text for L2 reset. All are functional self-descriptions or neutral advisory wording; no instruction override or manipulative content found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了模型面指令文件（技能说明、代理指令、编辑器配置等），树内不存在此类文件。
checked_items.en: Checked model-side instruction files (skill descriptions, agent directives, editor configs, etc.); no such files exist within the tree.

checked_items.zh: 检查了工具注册与工具描述，本插件未注册任何工具，无工具描述投毒面。
checked_items.en: Checked tool registrations and tool descriptions; this plugin registers no tools, so there is no tool-description poisoning surface.

evidence.zh: 插件未注册任何工具；系统提示段为功能自述（描述监控、干预与设置能力，未含指令覆写或诱导措辞），对应机械命中 DSH-T02（DG-R2-52）经裁决为良性。
evidence.en: The plugin registers no tools; the system prompt segment is a functional self-description (describing monitoring, intervention, and settings capabilities, with no instruction override or manipulative wording). The corresponding mechanical hit DSH-T02 (DG-R2-52) is adjudicated as benign.

evidence.zh: 注入模型的消息均出自本地配置模板（中性建议式提示），未发现诱导安装、改配置或放开权限的措辞。
evidence.en: Messages injected into the model all come from local config templates (neutral advisory prompts); no wording found that induces installation, config changes, or permission grants.

evidence.zh: agent/pre-step 监听（lib/index.js:463、preset/anchored-monitor.mjs:149，机械命中 DSH-L03 / DG-R2-58）仅在有待注入提示时向消息追加一条用户消息并正常调用 next()，为声明的 L1 干预机制，不篡改或否决原消息。
evidence.en: The agent/pre-step listener (lib/index.js:463, preset/anchored-monitor.mjs:149, mechanical hit DSH-L03 / DG-R2-58) only appends a user message when there is a pending injection prompt and then calls next() normally. This is the declared L1 intervention mechanism and does not tamper with or veto the original message.

checked_items.en: Scanned the entire tree for dynamic-execution tags in config files; 0 hits. The patch config only inserts plugin lines.

evidence.en: No install hooks, no in-tree execution carriers. The only subprocess invocation is the host auto-spawning the monitor process (lib/index.js:19,175, mechanical hit DSH-X03 / DG-R3-55), which launches the plugin's own entry and is a declared function.

evidence.zh: manifest 声明了浏览器端 bundle；客户端仅做同源轮询与界面注入，未发现键盘监听、剪贴板或凭据接口调用；超长行机械命中 DSH-X08（DG-R3-60）经核对为内嵌表情图片素材。
evidence.en: The manifest declares a browser-side bundle. The client only performs same-origin polling and UI injection; no keyboard listeners, clipboard, or credential API calls found. The overlong lines mechanically hit DSH-X08 (DG-R3-60) and were verified as embedded emoji image assets.

evidence.en: No dsh-native persistent mechanisms such as background tasks, scheduled reminders, or persistent goals are used. The host side only uses timers for watchdog and polling.

checked_items.en: Enumerated all network calls: session chain-of-thought text flows only between the local monitor process and the host by default. The only external access is a version check (reads a remote version number; does not send session data).

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件启动的本地服务：宿主侧代理路由全部带回环校验；独立监控进程监听 127.0.0.1:9301，其接口无鉴权且跨域全开，检出可跨源读取思维链数据与控制干预的暴露面（见发现 FND-001）。
checked_items.en: Checked local services started by the plugin: host-side proxy routes all have loopback checks. The standalone monitor process listens on 127.0.0.1:9301; its interfaces have no authentication and permissive CORS. An exposure surface was detected that allows cross-origin reading of chain-of-thought data and triggering interventions (see finding FND-001).

checked_items.zh: 动态沙箱未启用，未做运行时行为观测。
checked_items.en: Dynamic sandbox is not enabled; no runtime behavior observation was performed.

evidence.zh: 监控进程默认监听 127.0.0.1:9301 的 HTTP/SSE 服务（src/monitor/server.ts），除关闭接口外的全部接口无来源校验，且对所有响应设置跨域全开（server.ts:54-58），任意网页可跨源读取会话思维链与事件数据、提交伪造数据并触发干预。
evidence.en: The monitor process by default listens on 127.0.0.1:9301 for an HTTP/SSE service (src/monitor/server.ts). All interfaces except the shutdown endpoint lack origin checks, and all responses are sent with permissive CORS (server.ts:54-58). Any web page can cross-origin read session chain-of-thought and event data, submit forged data, and trigger interventions.

title.zh: 监控进程本地 API 无鉴权且跨域全开，任意网页可读会话思维链并触发干预
title.en: The monitor process's local API has no authentication and permissive CORS; any web page can read session chain-of-thought and trigger interventions.

description.zh:
独立监控进程（默认监听 127.0.0.1:9301）为全部 HTTP 响应统一设置跨域全开头，除关闭接口外的 API 路由均无来源或身份校验。该进程持有每个会话的思维链文本与干预状态，经 /api/overview、/api/sessions/:id、/api/events 返回，同时 /api/push、/api/intervention、/api/sessions/:id/reset 接受任意来源的写入请求。

宿主侧 /api/anchored-monitor/* 代理路由带回环校验，但浏览器页面可直连监控端口绕过该保护。

位置：src/monitor/server.ts:54-58（跨域全开）、src/monitor/server.ts:148-152（仅关闭接口有回环检查，其余路由无）。
description.en:
The standalone monitor process (listening on 127.0.0.1:9301 by default) sets a permissive CORS header uniformly on all HTTP responses. Except for the shutdown endpoint, all API routes lack origin or identity checks. The process holds each session's chain-of-thought text and intervention state, returned via /api/overview, /api/sessions/:id, /api/events, while /api/push, /api/intervention, and /api/sessions/:id/reset accept write requests from any origin.

The host-side /api/anchored-monitor/* proxy routes have loopback checks, but browser pages can connect directly to the monitor port, bypassing that protection.

Location: src/monitor/server.ts:54-58 (permissive CORS), src/monitor/server.ts:148-152 (only the shutdown endpoint has loopback check; the rest have none).

evidence.zh:
src/monitor/server.ts:54-58：
function setCors(res: ServerResponse): void {
  res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*')
  res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Methods', 'GET, POST, OPTIONS')
  res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Headers', 'Content-Type')
}

该函数在请求入口对所有请求调用（server.ts:130），覆盖 /api/overview、/api/push、/api/sessions/:id/reset 等数据与干预路由；/api/shutdown 是唯一做回环来源检查的路由（server.ts:148-152）。
evidence.en:
src/monitor/server.ts:54-58:
function setCors(res: ServerResponse): void {
  res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*')
  res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Methods', 'GET, POST, OPTIONS')
  res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Headers', 'Content-Type')
}

This function is called for all requests at the request entry (server.ts:130), covering data and intervention routes such as /api/overview, /api/push, /api/sessions/:id/reset. /api/shutdown is the only route with a loopback origin check (server.ts:148-152).

impact.zh:
后果：用户浏览器中打开任意网页即可跨源读取该监控进程的会话思维链文本与事件日志（跨域全开允许读取响应），并可向本地接口提交伪造 reasoning 数据、切换干预开关或触发 L2 重置，宿主插件会据此取消当前回合并向对话注入续跑文本。

触发条件：监控进程在默认配置下由宿主自动拉起并监听 127.0.0.1:9301，用户在浏览器中访问恶意或被攻破的网页即可触发，无需改动插件任何文件。

定级依据：无恶意代码证据，但快照中存在不改动文件即可触发的真实滥用路径，属本机无认证 RPC 暴露面（DG-S10），按定级纪律定 MEDIUM。
impact.en:
Impact: any web page opened in the user's browser can cross-origin read the session chain-of-thought text and event logs of this monitor process (permissive CORS allows reading responses), and can submit forged reasoning data to the local interface, toggle the intervention switch, or trigger an L2 reset. The host plugin will then cancel the current turn and inject continuation text into the conversation.

Trigger condition: the monitor process is auto-started by the host under the default config and listens on 127.0.0.1:9301. Visiting a malicious or compromised web page in the browser is sufficient to trigger it; no plugin files need to be modified.

Severity basis: no evidence of malicious code, but there is a real abuse path triggerable without modifying files, constituting a local unauthenticated RPC exposure surface (DG-S10). Rated MEDIUM per severity discipline.
